build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template using define_task_template decorator with seed and version parameters
create_dynamic_objects: create dynamic balls and jars in the PHYRE scene using C.add with scale and position
create_static_bars: create static bars in the PHYRE scene using C.add with randomized scale and center position
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task with body1, body2, and INSIDE spatial relationship using C.update_task
get_phantom_vertices: get phantom vertices from a dynamic jar object for collision detection in PHYRE tasks
